lesson: The system is consistently entering shorts during oversold conditions on lower timeframes, failing to account for liquidity sweeps that trigger mean-reversion rallies. The reliance on trend-following in a low-confidence environment has resulted in 6 consecutive stops as the market exhausts its bearish momentum.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'Liquidity Sweep' filter: do not enter shorts when the 15m RSI is below 30 unless a clear Wyckoff Spring or failure-to-break structure is confirmed on the 1h timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based trend continuation signals LESS in high-fear environments.
